links.outcome: Output stability across 5 repeated runs for three tasks
links.effect: Near-perfect stability for C-TIRADS (α=0.864 vs 0.866) and management (κ=0.853 vs 0.849); benign-malignant stability lower for ChatGPT-4o (κ=0.609) than DeepSeek-R1 (κ=0.869).
links.quote: Stability was near perfect for C-TIRADS classification (α=0.864 vs 0.866) and management recommendations (κ=0.853 vs. 0.849) in both models; however, DeepSeek-R1 showed markedly greater stability than ChatGPT-4o in benign-malignant differentiation (κ=0.869 vs 0.609; Δκ=0.260, 95% CI 0.191-0.321).

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic performance versus senior radiologists on benign-malignant differentiation
links.effect: Senior radiologists (AUC 0.865, accuracy 0.804) outperformed DeepSeek-R1 (accuracy 0.729) and ChatGPT-4o (accuracy 0.644).
links.quote: However, both LLMs remained inferior to senior radiologists, suggesting their role as decision-support tools rather than stand-alone diagnostic systems.

screen.reason: Multicenter retrospective evaluation of two LLMs (ChatGPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1) in interpreting thyroid nodule ultrasound reports across classification and recommendation tasks, without evaluating a specific operational guardrail or organizational deployment practice.
